posts.meta_description:
13K likes, 478 comments - daveramsey on July 25, 2026: "Do you make good money, but still wonder where it all went? You’re overdrafting, the debt keeps piling up, and you’re sick and tired of being sick and tired.
 
It’s time to take control.
 
Give every dollar a name before the month begins with @everydollar, start working the 7 Baby Steps, and attack your debt with the debt snowball.
 
You CAN do this. One year from now, your life can look completely different. Are you ready to make a change?".

posts.meta_description:
14K likes, 637 comments - daveramsey on March 29, 2025: "What an amazing week celebrating YOU on the Live Like No One Else Cruise!
 
It was a privilege to spend the week with you. Y’all are living proof that hard work, discipline, and financial peace are worth it! And a huge congratulations to everyone who participated in the world’s largest Debt-Free Scream. WOW, what an unforgettable moment.
 
I couldn’t be more proud of all of you and honored that you chose to spend this week with us. Thank you all again for making this an event we’ll all never forget. I hope you all had as much fun as I did!".

posts.meta_description:
This right here is what freedom sounds like! Thousands of you—who worked, sacrificed, and pushed through to become debt-free—just did the biggest debt-free scream in history. You’ve followed the 7 Baby Steps, you’ve said NO to debt, and now you get to say YES to the life you’ve always dreamed of.
 
YOU ALL are the heroes of this story. You fought to change your family tree, and today, we’re celebrating you.
 
When you live like no one else, later you get to live (and cruise!) like no one else. Way to go, debt-free heroes! Honored to celebrate with you this week. - @daveramsey on March 24, 2025

posts.meta_description:
1,965 likes, 29 comments - daveramsey on October 30, 2026: "Spending, saving, and giving are the three money skills everyone needs to learn.

Spending is learning to enjoy life with your money.

Saving is putting money aside for emergencies, college, and retirement to build wealth.

Giving is using the power of generosity to change who you are because giving is the most fun you will ever have with money.".

posts.meta_description:
2,086 likes, 97 comments - daveramsey on October 29, 2026: "I recommend and personally invest in good growth stock mutual funds spread across four types: growth and income, growth, aggressive growth, and international, and I only buy funds with at least a 10 year track record.

Your most powerful wealth-building tool is your income, and when you don’t have any payments, you have more money to invest to build wealth.".

13K likes, 196 comments - daveramsey on October 24, 2026: "Katie can’t afford her credit card payments and called in to The Ramsey Show for advice on what to do. We put her on an @everydollar  budget so she can plan every dollar before the month begins.

Remember, chaos and disorganization always eat all of your monthly income. When you tell every dollar where to go, you will feel like you got a raise.".
